transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get started. We've got the festival streaming special rough cut in front of us, and I need to hear from each of you before we make any decisions about locking the master. The hidden-camera comedy segment is currently in the cut, and this is going out to a general audience, so I need to know about any constraints from each of your areas. Let's go through the standing reporting round — standards, insurance, and delivery leads, in that order. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the participant releases and standards notes this morning, and I can confirm that the hidden-camera comedy segment may be included only if every participant's face is blurred and every participant's name is removed from the edit. I have not entered this result in the rough-cut notes yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I confirmed with the insurer yesterday that coverage for the hidden-camera comedy segment applies only when all visible participants are adults and each has a signed event waiver. So the final package must identify the participant scope as adults-only and record waiver collection. I should also note that I have not attached the endorsement to the production file yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I completed the platform ingest check today and confirmed that this special's delivery profile requires a runtime of exactly 11 minutes or less, 25 frames per second, and stereo audio. I have not updated the delivery worksheet yet.
